criteria.notes: Gallery storyline: venue identity, scene index, installation label, title, description, location line and a large scene numeral, rotating across scenes.
Editorial exhibition-card concept retained: flat colour block carrying the numeral beside a dark editorial column.
Reads as a gallery interpretation panel rather than a slideshow widget; the numeral block and scene index are concept-specific.
Scene titles and the location line reach their intended sizes; the long-copy and quote scenarios confirm body text stays legible.
Custom-theme, quote and schedule scenarios each swap the block colour while preserving numeral and body contrast.
Long-copy scenario fills the column with a complete multi-paragraph description; no ellipsis or clipped line.

The scene column uses a deliberate three-zone rhythm with the title near the top, body centred and location pinned above the index rail. Longer scenes fill that slack, as the long-copy and quote scenarios show. The empty state substitutes an explicit no-stories message.
Numeral block, index rail and brand mark render crisply from 600x600 through 1920x1080; no raster media involved.
The colour-block numeral composition is distinct from the table, dashboard and map examples.
